positions.name: MigrationDecisionRecord
positions.frame: how is the database migration decision established — spoken declaration versus written memo record?
positions.why: Both segments name the same PostgreSQL→QuantumDB switch as settled fact rather than proposal: src-1 performs the decision aloud ('We're switching'), src-3 ratifies it in writing under a memo heading. Conviction reads both as decision-grade (commitment-marker / performed-act), and relational/power reads both as authority-ranking, informational framing — the same directional stance (a closed, already-made call) expressed across two footings/channels. No `under` home is offered by the supplied strata or structure, so the field is omitted.

positions.name: PerformanceCostJustification
positions.frame: what justification is offered for the migration — performance and cost terms?
positions.why: src-2 (spoken) and src-4 (memo) both state the same '10x' performance figure as the rationale for the switch, in flat unhedged form. Power and relational reads mark both as rational-persuasion/reward and market-pricing framing — proportional cost-benefit argument rather than decree — and conviction reads both at claim-level (asserted, not yet ratified as commitment) in contrast to the decision-grade migration statements. This distinguishes the justification from the decision itself even though both concern the same switch. No `under` home is offered by the supplied strata or structure, so the field is omitted.
